name: gb-streptomycin-tuberculosis-trial
title: MRC streptomycin trial for pulmonary tuberculosis
description: The Medical Research Council trial of streptomycin plus bed rest versus bed rest alone in 107 young adults with acute progressive pulmonary tuberculosis, published in 1948 and widely seen as the first modern randomised controlled trial. Patient-level records reconstructed from the published report.

sources.title: Medical Research Council, Streptomycin in Tuberculosis Trials Committee, Streptomycin in Tuberculosis Trials Committee (1948). Streptomycin treatment of pulmonary tuberculosis. British Medical Journal 2(4582): 769-782

fields.name: dose_PAS_g
fields.description: Daily dose of para-aminosalicylic acid (g); 0 for everyone in this trial

fields.name: baseline_temp
fields.description: Maximum evening temperature at baseline, in four bands (degrees F)

fields.name: baseline_esr
fields.description: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate at baseline, in four bands (mm per hour)

fields.name: baseline_cavitation
fields.description: Cavitation on the baseline chest X-ray (yes, no)

fields.name: strep_resistance
fields.description: Streptomycin resistance at 6 months (1_sens_0-8 sensitive, 2_mod_8-99 moderate, 3_resist_100+ resistant)

fields.name: radiologic_6m
fields.description: Radiological response on chest X-ray at 6 months, from 1_Death to 6_Considerable_improvement

fields.name: rad_num
fields.description: Radiological response at 6 months as a number (1 death to 6 considerable improvement)

fields.name: improved
fields.description: Improved at 6 months (TRUE if rad_num is 5 or 6)
